svg.title: From ARP bytes to the Internet struct
svg.desc: The 28 bytes of an ARP request, field by field: hardware type 1, protocol type 0x0800, lengths 6 and 4, operation 1, then the sender and target hardware and protocol addresses. The Internet struct takes the two protocol addresses as source 192.168.0.114 and destination 192.168.0.1, has no payload_protocol and an empty payload, and keeps the whole ArpPacket in details.
